name: Hanzo Hattori
source:
"We live in two different worlds...you and me, princess."

The mature and reliable head of the Iga ninjas. His legendary powers are acknowledged even by other clans. However he doesn't know much about love, and he's famous for being a bit "dim" in that regard.
